description: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data shows TCP port 53 (DNS) open on an IPv4 address. It is a passive port fact only: it does not send a query, so it cannot say whether the server answers recursively for outside names. Absence means not seen, not closed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_open_resolver_check
title: Security Open Resolver Check
